Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. Hair continuity: black medium-loose; accent: offset braid. Preserve the front and side silhouette of medium-loose, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and offset braid; color remains black. Wardrobe continuity: short-jacket-trousers in indigo-sand; a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems. Condition: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale. Personal anchors: three hair rings. Add nothing new.
